takes.take_a: Original modern Japanese pop-rock anthem, heroic and urgent, about 60 seconds, 148 BPM, minor key that lifts to major in the chorus. Sung in Japanese by one male tenor: close, restless and low in the verse, then a huge soaring chorus with bright high notes and doubled harmonies. Instruments: an angular syncopated piano riff, tight funky electric bass, crisp live drums, sharp clean electric guitar, a sweeping string section in the chorus. Structure: 2 bar piano riff intro, verse, a rising pre-chorus with a drum fill and one beat of silence, then a full band chorus that hits hard on the first beat. End on the final chorus chord.
takes.take_b: Original contemporary J-pop anthem with a cinematic, heroic lift, about 60 seconds, 152 BPM. One male lead vocal in Japanese with an expressive, slightly husky tone, intimate in the verse and wide open in the chorus. Off-kilter syncopated rhythm section, playful piano and guitar interplay, rubbery bass, tight live drums, then soaring strings and stacked vocal harmonies in the chorus. Structure: short intro, verse, a pre-chorus that climbs and stops dead for one beat, then a powerful chorus with a memorable rising melody. End on the final chorus chord.

lyrics:
[Verse]
灰の町で 息をひそめて
消えない火を 胸に隠した

[Pre-Chorus]
風が変わる 夜が割れる
ひとりでいい 手を伸ばせ

[Chorus]
のろしを上げろ 空の果てまで
届くまで 僕は叫ぶ
のろしを上げろ 誰かの夜に
この火を 繋いでいけ
